Sick to my stomach every time I pick up a box from something I ordered for my personal collection and hear the glass clinking inside 😫 I know buying things through marketplace or through an app that some of those people don’t ship glass often. But I feel like it’s a little common sense to wrap, pack and pad appropriately. 

I received this fairy lamp shattered even though there is bubble wrap in the box. The lamp pieces were not wrapped securely (they used no tape or cling wrap) and as a result it came shattered. 

Friendly reminder: you can never over wrap or over pad with glass 😎

Three ways to make the kitchen a little more fun.
1. A 1980s CBK set of four ceramic measuring scoops with little cow heads on the handles. 
2. Salty and Peppy, 1950s Japan chef shakers in hand-painted plaid jackets. 
3. An Arnel's mushroom cruet set from the 1970s, buttery yellow with raised cream mushrooms, a matching tray and salt and pepper shakers.

Which one completes your kitchen? Comment 1, 2 or 3.
